decisions.reason: As an incremental modular update of an already accepted trommel screen, it sits squarely in the firm's existing screening knowledge base and by 2022 would likely be retained as a low-risk extension of the core range.

The mobile high-speed grinder remains close to the firm's established mobile recycling machinery competences, so management would usually keep learning and refining it unless sales proved clearly disappointing.

The stationary electric fine shredder fits both the firm's stationary shredding expertise and its resource-saving development path, which makes continued commercialization more likely than withdrawal.

Although this green-waste grinder is related to the firm's grinder know-how and customer base, its narrower niche and overlap with broader grinder lines leave it more exposed if demand is not strong enough.
Stationary single-shaft pre-shredders are highly aligned with the firm's deep shredding capabilities and service infrastructure, so absorptive capacity arguments favor keeping and improving the line.
